basic_details.job_title: NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate I Posts
basic_details.short_information: One contract position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate I is open in a research project of the Department of Architecture and Planning, NIT Calicut, sponsored by the Centre of Excellence in Urban Planning & Design, NIT Calicut. The engagement is for 11 months, with a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA for JRF or Rs. 30,000/- + 20% HRA for Project Associate I. A first-class Master's degree with a B.Arch/B.Tech is required (plus GATE for JRF). Applications go by email by 9 December 2026, and the offline interview is scheduled for 15 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill the registration form provided with the notice (as annexed).
Attach the most recent CV and soft copies of the mark sheets/certificates that support your academic qualification/ experience.
Consolidate all the soft copies into a single PDF document (the notice says they "may be" combined this way).
E-mail the application to [email protected] AND [email protected], with a copy to [email protected].
Write the subject line "Application for JRF/2026/INSIGHT-NMA".
Send it by 09/12/2026, the last date for application submission.
Mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/ experience
"No Objection Certificate" from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organization)
important_instructions: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photograph submitted. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Anthropogenic Heat from Air Conditioning and Street Level Thermal Stress: Field-Validated Microclimate Modelling and Mitigation Strategies
Centre of Excellence in Urban Planning & Design, NIT Calicut
11 Months (on contract basis), extendable for 1 more year
JRF: Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA; Project Associate I: Rs. 30,000/- + 20% HRA
NIT Calicut; New Delhi as and when required

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single position is filled either as a Junior Research Fellow or as a Project Associate I. The notice gives separate qualifications for each, joined by "OR". Master's degree with First Class in Architecture or Planning or Engineering (Sustainable Architecture/ Environmental Engineering or equivalent) from a recognised University, and B.Arch/B.Tech Degree in Civil/ Mechanical Engineering or equivalent, and Qualified GATE in Architecture & Planning/ Civil Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. Master's degree with First Class in Architecture or Planning or Engineering from a recognised University, and B.Arch/B.Tech Degree in Civil/ Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. The candidate should be willing to be stationed at New Delhi and NIT Calicut as and when required. The candidate should be fluent in Hindi communication. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials. The notice does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The 20% HRA is paid on top of the consolidated monthly pay for both posts. The engagement is for 11 months on contract basis and is extendable for 1 more year based on the performance of the candidate and availability of the project fund.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the registration form provided with the notice (as annexed). Attach the most recent CV and soft copies of the mark sheets/certificates that support your academic qualification/ experience. Consolidate all the soft copies into a single PDF document (the notice says they "may be" combined this way). E-mail the application to [email protected] AND [email protected] , with a copy to [email protected] . Write the subject line "Application for JRF/2026/INSIGHT-NMA". Send it by 09/12/2026, the last date for application submission. Filled registration form Most recent CV Mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/ experience "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organization)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first. After shortlisting, eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the interview. The interview is an "Offline" interview scheduled to be held on 15 December 2026. Employed applicants must submit the No Objection Certificate at the time of interview along with the above-mentioned documents.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photograph submitted. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 for JRF/Project Associate I?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) position, to be filled as either Junior Research Fellow or Project Associate I.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut JRF/Project Associate I post?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: JRF needs a Master's degree with First Class in Architecture or Planning or Engineering (Sustainable Architecture/ Environmental Engineering or equivalent), a B.Arch/B.Tech in Civil/ Mechanical Engineering or equivalent, and Qualified GATE in Architecture & Planning/ Civil Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. Project Associate I needs the first-class Master's degree and the B.Arch/B.Tech, without GATE.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NIT Calicut JRF and Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA for JRF and Rs. 30,000/- + 20% HRA for Project Associate I.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, 20% HRA is added to the consolidated monthly pay for both JRF and Project Associate I.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Calicut JRF/Project Associate I post?
faq.answer: Email the filled registration form, recent CV and certificates as one PDF to [email protected] AND [email protected], with a copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should I use in the application email?
faq.answer: Use the subject line "Application for JRF/2026/INSIGHT-NMA".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted, and eligible candidates are notified by email and invited to an offline interview scheduled for 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract basis for 11 months, extendable for 1 more year based on the candidate's performance and availability of the project fund.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
